articles.title: ATF prices for international airlines slashed 27%; domestic rates unchanged
articles.titleEn: ATF prices for international airlines slashed 27%; domestic rates unchanged
articles.summary: International airlines see a significant 27 percent cut in jet fuel prices. Domestic carriers, however, continue to pay unchanged rates. Commercial LPG prices have reached record highs. Household LPG and fuel prices for petrol and diesel remain steady. These revisions reflect monthly price reviews by state-owned oil companies amidst global energy market shifts.

articles.title: Commercial LPG Rates Up From June 1; 19 Kg Cylinder Costlier by ₹42 In Delhi, Govt Assures Sufficient Stocks
articles.titleEn: Commercial LPG Rates Up From June 1; 19 Kg Cylinder Costlier by ₹42 In Delhi, Govt Assures Sufficient Stocks
articles.summary: Commercial LPG cylinder prices have increased from June 1, with 19 kg cylinders becoming costlier by Rs 42 in Delhi and Rs 53.50 in Kolkata, while domestic LPG prices remain unchanged. The government assured adequate fuel stocks and no supply shortage, highlighting efforts to build strategic reserves, curb hoarding through raids, and maintain uninterrupted LPG, petrol, and diesel supplies.
